topic: Hs (CN-TT) general gas-composition study — composition monitoring (MC-4) for breathing / life-support / process gas.
purpose: Local AI-assist node: topic-specific knowledge + the link up to the full Hs AI-refresh control chain. Self-serve / bring-your-own-AI entry point for assessing Hs on the gas domain.
paths_note: specific_knowledge.key_files are relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain and related_topics paths are relative to the Hs repo root.

specific_knowledge.what: A breathing or life-support gas (O2/CO2/N2, anaesthesia agents) is a composition that drifts over time. Hs reads it deterministically: which gas drives a change (helmsman), when the regime shifts (boundaries), effective diversity (K_eff), and -- with two channels -- real change vs sensor fault / mask leak (internal-vs-external shock), each with a hash receipt. This is MC-4 (the fourth monitoring category) -- what single-threshold magnitude alarms miss.
key_files: produced-water-codawork/ (Study 2: oil&gas produced water, CoDaWork/Engle, USGS DB)
key_results: Tier 1: lossless compositional read to 8.9e-16 (machine precision); deterministic content hash a94bc2ad...
Tier 1: CO2 correctly named the helmsman through a CO2-scrubber drift event; regime boundary detected at minute 39; K_eff range 1.62-1.98

Tier 1: RATIO-BLINDNESS RESULT -- 40 of 60 timesteps had every single-channel alarm green while the composition was moving; in a sub-threshold window MC-4 (Aitchison) motion ran ~2.5x the nominal baseline with all single-channel alarms still green
Tier 2: the synthetic O2/CO2/N2 scenarios faithfully model closed-loop gas behaviour; the MC-4-vs-MC-1 argument
Tier 3: any clinical/flight conclusion; results on real public data (VitalDB/PhysioNet) -- the specified verification, not yet run
related_topics: HUF/huf-gov/RATIO_BLINDNESS_DOCTRINE.md (MC-4: see or remain blind; cost ~1/4)
Hs/SPACE_READINESS_AND_CHALLENGE.md (closed-loop life-support gas is a space application area)
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = the computed engine outputs above; Tier 2 = synthetic faithfulness + the MC-4-vs-MC-1 framing; Tier 3 = clinical/flight claims and the public-data (VitalDB) run.

bring_your_own_ai: Point any AI/agent at this file to self-onboard on the gas-composition topic, then follow join_the_chain for the full system. To reproduce: run code/make_gas_series.py then HCI-CNTT/run_cntt.py on the CSV. Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply.
